They never sign in.\\n- **Editors** (Co-President, Social Chair, Treasurer Accounts) post the Study Hall reminder and other news.\\n- **Admins** (the Co-VP Account) run the site.\\n\\n### The seven required capabilities, in AWM's words\\n\\n1. **Login.** Each Position's Account signs in and out of the console. Passwords are stored as argon2 hashes.\\n2. **Two roles.** Admin (Co-VP) and Editor (Co-President, Social Chair, Treasurer), with different permissions enforced in code.\\n3. **Posts.** Officers create, read, update, and delete Posts: title, Link, Markdown body, Draft/Published, Author (a Position), and timestamps.\\n4. **Pages.** Home, About, and Join & Snacks, with the same fields. Published Pages make up the public navigation.\\n5. **Admin console.** A dashboard with counts and the Go live status, one content list that filters by status and type, and an editor with a preview.\\n6. **Account management.** Admin only: create an Account for a Position, change its Role, set its password, and deactivate it. A Deactivated Account cannot sign in.\\n7. **Public site and Go live.** Only Published content, sanitized Markdown, navigation built from Pages, and `cms publish` writing `site/` with relative paths. Go live is the button that runs it and pushes the result.\\n\\n## User Stories\\n\\n### Visitors\\n\\n1. As a curious student who is not on the email list, I want to see when and where Study Hall is on a public Home Page, so that I can show up without asking anyone.\\n2. As a member, I want to see the latest Post in full on the Home Page, so that I know what is happening this week without needing the Weekly email.\\n3. As a member, I want every Post to show its date with the weekday, so that I know which Monday \\\"tonight\\\" refers to.\\n4. As a member, I want a Past posts list, so that I can find an older Post.\\n5. As a member who clicked the Link in the Weekly email, I want to land on that exact Post, so that the email and the site agree.\\n6. As a member, I want a Link from an earlier Weekly email to keep working, so that I never hit a dead page.\\n7. As a curious student, I want an About Page describing AWM and its Officers, so that I know who runs it.\\n8. As a curious student, I want a Join & Snacks Page with the Google Form link, so that I can join or request snacks.\\n9. As a Visitor, I want the same navigation on every public page, so that I can move between Home, About, and Join & Snacks.\\n10. As a Visitor, I want never to see a Draft, so that I only read what the Officers meant to publish.\\n11. As a Visitor on a phone, I want the site to fit my screen, so that I can check the room on the way to Hayes.\\n12. As a Visitor, I want Posts to read as coming from AWM with no individual name, so that it matches the Weekly email.\\n\\n### Signing in\\n\\n13. As an Officer, I want to sign in with my Position's Account, so that I can use the console.\\n14. As an Officer, I want to sign out, so that the next Officer at the laptop does not act as my Position.\\n15. As an Officer, I want to be signed out when the browser closes, so that a forgotten sign-out does not leave the Account open.\\n16. As an Officer who mistypes, I want a clear \\\"wrong email or password\\\" message, so that I can try again.\\n17. As a Co-VP, I want that message to be the same whether or not the Account exists, so that it gives nothing away.\\n18. As a Co-VP, I want anyone who is not signed in to be sent to the sign-in screen, so that no console screen is visible without an Account.\\n\\n### Editors and Posts\\n\\n19. As a new Officer, I want to write the Study Hall reminder in a plain text box, so that I never have to learn HTML.\\n20. As an Editor, I want a short hint under the text box showing how to make bold text and a link, so that I can add the Google Form link without looking anything up.\\n21. As an Editor, I want to save a Post as a Draft, so that I can finish it later.\\n22. As an Editor, I want to preview a Post before I publish it, so that I can see what Visitors will see.\\n23. As an Editor, I want to mark a Post Published, so that it goes out at the next Go live.\\n24. As an Editor, I want the Post's Link to be made for me from the date and title, so that I never have to type one.\\n25. As an Editor, I want two reminders with the same title to get different Links, so that every week's Post has its own address.\\n26. As an Editor, I want to fix a typo in a Published Post without its Link changing, so that the email link still works.\\n27. As an Editor, I want to set a Post back to Draft, so that I can pull something published by mistake.\\n28. As an Editor, I want to edit any Post, including one written by another Position, so that whoever is at the laptop can fix it.\\n29. As an Editor, I want to delete any Post after an \\\"Are you sure?\\\" step, so that a cancelled or wrong Post can be removed.\\n30. As an Editor, I want to post things other than the weekly reminder (a cancelled Study Hall, a snack update), so that all news goes through one kind of Post.\\n31. As an Editor, I want a message after every save, publish, or delete saying what happened, so that I know it worked.\\n32. As an Editor, I want to see the Post's public address once it is live, so that I can copy it into the Weekly email.\\n\\n### Editors and Pages\\n\\n33. As an Editor, I want to edit the text of an existing Page, so that I can update the Study Hall room or the Officer list.\\n34. As a Co-VP, I want an Editor to be unable to create a Page, so that nobody adds to the navigation by accident.\\n35. As a Co-VP, I want an Editor to be unable to delete a Page, so that the site's structure is safe.\\n36. As a Co-VP, I want an Editor to be unable to change a Page's status, so that a Page cannot vanish from the navigation.\\n37. As an Editor who types an Admin-only address directly, I want a clear \\\"no permission\\\" screen, so that I know it is not broken.\\n\\n### Co-VPs (Admins)\\n\\n38. As a Co-VP, I want to create a Page, so that the site can grow when AWM needs it to.\\n39. As a Co-VP, I want to delete a Page other than Home after an \\\"Are you sure?\\\" step, so that I can remove one we no longer need.\\n40. As a Co-VP, I want to set a Page to Draft or Published, so that I control what is in the navigation.\\n41. As a Co-VP, I want Home to be impossible to delete or unpublish, so that the site always has a front page.\\n42. As a Co-VP, I want to change the Study Hall time or room in one place, so that it is never out of date in a second file.\\n43. As a Co-VP, I want a Go live button, so that I can update the public site without a terminal.\\n44. As a Co-VP, I want the dashboard to show when the last Go live was, so that I know how current the public site is.\\n45. As a Co-VP, I want a warning with the number of changes that are Not live yet, so that a Published reminder is never left unseen.\\n46. As a Co-VP, I want a plain error if Go live fails, so that I know the public site did not change.\\n47. As a Co-VP, I want Editors not to have the Go live button, so that going public stays with us.\\n48. As a Co-VP, I want to see every Account with its Position, Role, and whether it is Deactivated, so that I know who can sign in.\\n49. As a Co-VP, I want to create an Account for a new Position and choose its Role, so that a new Officer job can post.\\n50. As a Co-VP, I want to change an Account's Role, so that a Position's permissions can change.\\n51. As a Co-VP, I want to set a new password for any Account, so that a forgotten password or a Handover is a one-minute fix.\\n52. As a Co-VP, I want to deactivate the Account of a vacant Position, so that it cannot sign in.\\n53. As a Co-VP, I want to reactivate an Account, so that a Position that returns can post again.\\n54. As a Co-VP, I want a Deactivated Account's Posts to stay on the site, so that history is not lost.\\n55. As a Co-VP, I want the console to refuse to deactivate or demote the last active Admin, so that we cannot lock ourselves out.\\n\\n### Everyone in the console\\n\\n56. As an Officer, I want a dashboard with counts of Draft Posts, Published Posts, and Pages, so that I see the state of the site at a glance.\\n57. As an Officer, I want one content list of Posts and Pages, newest first, so that I can find anything.\\n58. As an Officer, I want to filter that list by Draft/Published and by Post/Page, so that I can find last week's reminder quickly.\\n59. As an Officer, I want the list to show each Post's Author as a Position, so that I know which Position wrote it.\\n60. As an Officer, I want the same navigation on every console screen, so that I never get lost.\\n61. As an Officer on a phone-width window, I want console screens not to scroll sideways, so that they stay usable.\\n\\n### Running and grading\\n\\n62. As the developer, I want a seed command that creates the demo Accounts, the three Pages, and a few Posts (at least one Draft, one Published), so that the CMS can be used immediately from a clean clone.\\n63. As the developer, I want `cms publish` and `cms deploy` to keep working from the terminal, so that the documented commands still work alongside the button.\\n\\n## Implementation Decisions\\n\\n### Modules\\n\\n- **Accounts and sessions.** Verifies a sign-in, hashes passwords with argon2, keeps the session in a signed cookie that ends when the browser closes, and exposes one guard for \\\"must be signed in\\\" and one for \\\"must be Admin\\\". All permission checks go through these guards, never through hidden links alone.\\n- **Content.** One module that owns Posts and Pages: saving, status changes, Link generation, deletion, and the rules about who may do what. Routes ask it; they do not decide permissions themselves.\\n- **Markdown rendering.** One function turns a Markdown body into sanitized HTML. The editor preview, the local public preview, and the export all call this same function, so nothing can be rendered unsanitized.\\n- **Site export.** The existing export function is extended to write the whole public site from Published rows only.\\n- **Go live.** Runs the export, pushes the result, and records the time. It is called by the dashboard button and by the `cms deploy` command.\\n- **Admin console.** Dashboard, content list, editor, Accounts screen, sign-in screen. Server-rendered templates, no JavaScript framework (ADR-002).\\n- **Seed script.** Extended to create demo Accounts, Pages, and Posts.\\n\\n### Data\\n\\n- **Account:** sign-in email (unique), display name (the Position, e.g. \\\"Social Chair\\\"), password hash, Role (`admin` or `editor`), active flag, created time.\\n- **Post:** title, Link (unique among Posts), Markdown body, status (`draft` or `published`), Author (an Account), created time, updated time, first-published time.\\n- **Page:** the same fields, plus a marker for which Page is Home.\\n- **Site state:** the time of the last Go live, and a count of changes that are Not live yet.\\n- Storage is SQLite (ADR-002). The database file is never committed.\\n\\n### Rules\\n\\n- **Roles.** Editors: create, edit, publish, unpublish, and delete any Post; edit the body of any existing Page. Admins: everything Editors can do, plus create and delete Pages, change a Page's title and status, manage Accounts, and Go live.\\n- **Home.** Created automatically if missing. Cannot be deleted or set to Draft by anyone. Its body holds the standing Study Hall time and place.\\n- **Links.** A Post's Link is the date plus a URL-safe form of the title (for example `2026-10-05-study-hall-tonight`). If that Link already exists, a number is added. A Page's Link is the URL-safe form of its title. A Link is set when the item is first Published and never changes after that, even if the title changes or the item goes back to Draft and is Published again. Officers never type a Link.\\n- **Dates.** A Post's public date is its first-published time, shown with the weekday. Dates are shown in US Eastern time.\\n- **Deleting.** Deleting a Post or Page is permanent and always goes through a confirmation screen. There is no trash.\\n- **Accounts.** Accounts are deactivated, never deleted. A Deactivated Account cannot sign in, and an existing session for it stops working. The last active Admin cannot be deactivated or changed to Editor.\\n- **Passwords.** Only an Admin sets a password, from the Accounts screen. No password is ever logged or shown.\\n- **Not live yet.** Any change that would alter the public site adds one to the count: publishing or unpublishing, editing or deleting something Published. Edits to Drafts do not count. Go live resets the count to zero.\\n- **Go live.** Admin only. If the push fails, the console shows a plain error, and the count and last Go live time are left as they were.\\n\\n### Contracts\\n\\n- Sign-in is a form posted to `/login` with fields `email` and `password`, matching the template's test helper. The console lives under `/admin`.\\n- Every state-changing request is a POST carrying a CSRF token, including sign-out, delete, and Go live. A POST without a valid token is rejected.\\n- An anonymous request to any console screen redirects to sign-in. A signed-in Editor requesting an Admin-only screen gets a 403 \\\"no permission\\\" screen.\\n- Wrong email and wrong password give the same message.\\n- `/` on the local app is a preview of the public site and shows Published content only.\\n\\n### Public site layout\\n\\n- Home at the site root; one file per other Published Page; one file per Published Post in a posts folder; a Past posts list in that folder; one stylesheet.\\n- Navigation: Home first, then the other Published Pages in the order they were created, which gives Home, About, Join & Snacks. Past posts is linked from Home, not from the navigation.\\n- Home shows its own body, then the latest Published Post in full. Past posts lists the older Published Posts, newest first.\\n- Every `href` and `src` is relative. Files in the posts folder reach the stylesheet and the Pages with `../`.\\n- No Author is shown publicly.\\n- Raw HTML typed into a body is not passed through, and the rendered HTML is sanitized with an allowlist. Images are not in the allowlist.\\n\\n### Demo data\\n\\n- The seed creates four Accounts: Co-VP (Admin), and Co-President, Social Chair, and Treasurer (Editors). The Co-VP signs in as `admin@example.test` and the Social Chair as `editor@example.test`, matching the template's test helper; the other two use `copresident@example.test` and `treasurer@example.test`.\\n- Passwords come from the environment. All three Editor Accounts use the one Editor demo password.\\n- The seed creates Home, About, and Join & Snacks as Published Pages, and at least one Published and one Draft Post.\\n\\n### Screens\\n\\n- Every console screen has the same navigation and shows a success or error message after each action.\\n- The editor has a formatting hint under the body box (bold, link) and a Preview button that shows the sanitized rendering.\\n- Once a Post is live, the editor shows its full public address, built from the configured public site address.\\n- No horizontal scrolling at 390 px on the public Home page or the console screens.\\n\\n## Testing Decisions\\n\\nA good test here drives the app the way an Officer or Visitor does and checks what they would see: a status code, a redirect, text on a screen, or a file in the exported site. Tests do not reach into the database or call internal functions to check how something was stored.\\n\\n### Seams\\n\\nThere are two seams, and both already exist in the template.\\n\\n1. **The console over HTTP.** Tests use the existing `client` and `client_as(\\\"admin\\\" | \\\"editor\\\")` fixtures to request screens and post forms. This covers sign-in, Roles, Posts, Pages, the dashboard, the content list, preview, Accounts, CSRF, and Go live.\\n2. **The exported site.** Tests call the export into a temporary folder and read the files it wrote. This covers Published-only content, navigation, relative paths, sanitizing, dates, and Links.\\n\\nOne thing is replaced in tests: the push to GitHub inside Go live. Tests swap it for a fake that records it was called (or fails on purpose), so no test ever pushes to the real repository.\\n\\nEach test runs against its own temporary database seeded with the demo Accounts, so the fixed test passwords in the fixtures work.\\n\\n### What gets tested\\n\\n- Every row of `SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md` has at least one test.\\n- Each Role rule has a test for the allowed case and the refused case, requested by direct URL rather than by clicking.\\n- Draft content never appears in the export, the local preview, or the Past posts list.\\n- A body containing `<script>` and an `onerror=` attribute is harmless in both the preview and the export.\\n- Link rules: same-title collision, frozen after Published.\\n- Last-Admin protection, Home protection, Deactivated sign-in refusal.\\n- Not live yet count goes up on public-affecting changes and resets on Go live; a failed push leaves it unchanged.\\n\\n### Prior art\\n\\n`tests/test_t00.py` already uses both seams. Its four tests are kept. One must change when sign-in lands: it currently expects an anonymous request to `/admin` to return the \\\"hello admin\\\" page, which contradicts the rule that anonymous Visitors are redirected to sign-in. It becomes two assertions: anonymous is redirected, and a signed-in Officer sees the dashboard.\\n\\n## Out of Scope\\n\\n- Sending the Weekly email. It stays manual; the CMS only supplies the Link.\\n- Hosting the snack request form. Join & Snacks links to the Google Form.\\n- Scheduled Posts or a calendar.\\n- Comments, or any Visitor sign-in.\\n- Image uploads, including Officer photos on About, and images linked from other sites. A console upload for Pages with alt text may be added later as a separate `stretch` issue, only after all seven capabilities work.\\n- Categories, tags, and search.\\n- A trash bin or undo for deleted Posts.\\n- \\\"Forgot my password\\\" emails.\\n- A \\\"copy last week's reminder\\\" button. This is the first future improvement.\\n- One Account per person (see ADR-003).\\n- Putting the console on the internet (see ADR-001).\\n- Multi-site, drag-and-drop page builders, and rich-text editors (excluded by the assignment).\\n\\n## Further Notes\\n\\n","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"85a3313b-4155-41fb-a47d-f637e6d103f6","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/home/msgre/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/home/msgre/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":1},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"msgrespin/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"msgrespin/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"msgrespin/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/home/msgre/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"wsl"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"bd12ad20-02de-4d3e-a1cb-0090d2742041","session_id":"2033201e-25ce-4be7-b1a2-f9cd7e6f34fb","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/msgre/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"e127c17f-a576-48c7-b58c-59cfdf744a1e","version":"2.1.286","gitBranch":"main"}

Safe to run twice.\"\"\"\n   153\t    init_db()\n   154\t    with connect() as conn:\n   155\t        if conn.execute(\"select 1 from posts\").fetchone():\n   156\t            return\n   157\t        author = conn.execute(\"select id from accounts where display_name = 'Social Chair'\"\n   158\t                              ).fetchone()\n   159\t        if author is None:\n   160\t            return\n   161\t    published = create_post(\n   162\t        \"Study Hall tonight\",\n   163\t        \"Hello everybody!\\n\\n\"\n   164\t        \"We are CURRENTLY having our study hall tonight from 8-10 in Hayes 311. \"\n   165\t        \"All are welcome and we will have lots of free snacks!\\n\\n\"\n   166\t        \"Come and say hi!\\n\\n\"\n   167\t        \"\\\\- AWM &lt;3\",\n   168\t        author[\"id\"])\n   169\t    set_status(published, \"published\")\n   170\t    create_post(\"Snack request form is open\",\n   171\t                \"Draft: Study Hall is every Monday, 8-10pm in Hayes 311, with free snacks. \"\n   172\t                \"Tell us what snacks you want. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n     4\tEvery href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\", \"../style.css\"),\n     5\tnever root-absolute, because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     6\t\n     7\tThe render_* functions are also what the local preview at / calls, so the\n     8\tpreview and the export cannot disagree.\n     9\t\"\"\"\n    10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    11\t\n    12\timport shutil\n    13\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n    16\t\n    17\tfrom markupsafe import Markup\n    18\t\n    19\tfrom app import content, markdown, settings\n    20\t\n    21\tCSS = \"\"\"/* Public site styles. */\n    22\t:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\n    23\tbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n    24\theader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n    25\tmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n    26\tarticle { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n    27\t.date { margin-block: 0 1rem; opacity: 0.75; }\n    28\t\"\"\"\n    29\t\n    30\t\n    31\tdef environment() -> Environment:\n    32\t    return Environment(\n    33\t        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n    34\t        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    35\t    )\n    36\t\n    37\t\n    38\tdef _view(row) -> dict:\n    39\t    \"\"\"What a Visitor sees of a Post. The Author is deliberately not here.\"\"\"\n    40\t    return {\"title\": row[\"title\"], \"link\": row[\"link\"],\n    41\t            \"date\": content.public_date(row[\"first_published_at\"]),\n    42\t            \"body_html\": Markup(markdown.render(row[\"body\"]))}\n    43\t\n    44\t\n    45\tdef _render(template: str, depth: int, **context) -> str:\n    46\t    up = \"../\" * depth\n    47\t    return environment().get_template(template).render(\n    48\t        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, css_path=f\"{up}style.css\",\n    49\t        home_path=f\"{up}index.html\", **context)\n    50\t\n    51\t\n    52\tdef render_front(rows=None) -> str:\n    53\t    posts = content.published_posts() if rows is None else rows\n    54\t    return _render(\"public/home.html\", 0, latest=_view(posts[0]) if posts else None,\n    55\t                   past_href=\"posts/index.html\")\n    56\t\n    57\t\n    58\tdef render_past(rows=None) -> str:\n    59\t    posts = content.published_posts() if rows is None else rows\n    60\t    return _render(\"public/past.html\", 1, posts=[_view(row) for row in posts[1:]])\n    61\t\n    62\t\n    63\tdef render_post(link: str, rows=None) -> str | None:\n    64\t    for row in (content.published_posts() if rows is None else rows):\n    65\t        if row[\"link\"] == link:\n    66\t            return _render(\"public/post.html\", 1, post=_view(row),\n    67\t                           past_href=\"index.html\")\n    68\t    return None\n    69\t\n    70\t\n    71\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    72\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n    73\t    rows = content.published_posts()\n    74\t    # Render everything before touching the folder, so a failure leaves the\n    75\t    # previous site/ in place instead of an empty one.\n    76\t    pages = {\"index.html\": render_front(rows), \"posts/index.html\": render_past(rows)}\n    77\t    for row in rows:\n    78\t        pages[f\"posts/{row['link']}.html\"] = render_post(row[\"link\"], rows)\n    79\t    if out.exists():\n    80\t        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    81\t    (out / \"posts\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    82\t    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    83\t    for name, html in pages.items():\n    84\t        (out / name).write_text(html)\n    85\t    return out\n=== app/main.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n     2\t\n     3\tT00 (already done): the admin console answers at /admin and the public site\n     4\tanswers at /. That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\n     5\truns before you build anything on it.\n     6\t\n     7\tAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\n     8\tthem here. Keep this file small.\n     9\t\"\"\"\n    10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    11\t\n    12\tfrom fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException\n    13\tfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, Response\n    14\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n    15\t\n    16\tfrom app import accounts, content, publish, settings\n    17\tfrom app.routes import auth, posts\n    18\t\n    19\t\n    20\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    21\t    accounts.init_db()\n    22\t    content.init_db()\n    23\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    24\t    # max_age=None: a session cookie with no Expires/Max-Age, so it ends when the\n    25\t    # browser closes.\n    26\t    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n    27\t                       session_cookie=\"session\", max_age=None,\n    28\t                       same_site=\"lax\", https_only=False)\n    29\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    30\t    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    31\t\n    32\t    # The local preview of the public site: the same renderers the export uses,\n    33\t    # at the same relative paths, so it shows Published content only.\n    34\t    @app.get(\"/\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    35\t    def public_home():\n    36\t        return publish.render_front()\n    37\t\n    38\t    @app.get(\"/style.css\")\n    39\t    def public_css():\n    40\t        return Response(publish.CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n    41\t\n    42\t    @app.get(\"/posts/index.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    43\t    def public_past():\n    44\t        return publish.render_past()\n    45\t\n    46\t    @app.get(\"/posts/{link}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    47\t    def public_post(link: str):\n    48\t        page = publish.render_post(link)\n    49\t        if page is None:\n    50\t            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Post.\")\n    51\t        return page\n    52\t\n    53\t    # Your ticket work plugs in here, e.g.\n    54\t    #   from app.routes import posts\n    55\t    #   app.include_router(posts.router)\n    56\t    return app\n    57\t\n    58\t\n    59\tapp = create_app()\n=== app/accounts.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Accounts and sessions.\n     2\t\n     3\tAn Account belongs to a Position, not a person (ADR-003). This module stores\n     4\tAccounts, hashes passwords with argon2, verifies a sign-in, and exposes the\n     5\tguard routes use for \"must be signed in\". Passwords are never logged or stored\n     6\tin plain text.\n     7\t\"\"\"\n     8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     9\t\n    10\timport secrets\n    11\timport sqlite3\n    12\tfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n    13\tfrom typing import Iterator\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\n    16\tfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n    17\tfrom fastapi import HTTPException, Request\n    18\t\n    19\tfrom app import settings\n    20\t\n    21\t_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n    22\t# Verified against when the email is unknown, so both failures take similar time.\n    23\t_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(\"not-a-real-password\")\n    24\t\n    25\tSCHEMA = \"\"\"\n    26\tcreate table if not exists accounts (\n    27\t    id integer primary key,\n    28\t    email text not null unique,\n    29\t    display_name text not null,\n    30\t    password_hash text not null,\n    31\t    role text not null check (role in ('admin', 'editor')),\n    32\t    active integer not null default 1,\n    33\t    created_at text not null default (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n    34\t)\n    35\t\"\"\"\n    36\t\n    37\t# Position, email, role, which demo password it uses.\n    38\tDEMO_ACCOUNTS = [\n    39\t    (\"Co-VP\", \"admin@example.test\", \"admin\", \"admin\"),\n    40\t    (\"Social Chair\", \"editor@example.test\", \"editor\", \"editor\"),\n    41\t    (\"Co-President\", \"copresident@example.test\", \"editor\", \"editor\"),\n    42\t    (\"Treasurer\", \"treasurer@example.test\", \"editor\", \"editor\"),\n    43\t]\n    44\t\n    45\t\n    46\t@contextmanager\n    47\tdef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    48\t    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    49\t    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    50\t    try:\n    51\t        with conn:\n    52\t            yield conn\n    53\t    finally:\n    54\t        conn.close()\n    55\t\n    56\t\n    57\tdef init_db() -> None:\n    58\t    with connect() as conn:\n    59\t        conn.execute(SCHEMA)\n    60\t\n    61\t\n    62\tdef create_account(email: str, display_name: str, password: str, role: str) -> None:\n    63\t    with connect() as conn:\n    64\t        conn.execute(\n    65\t            \"insert into accounts (email, display_name, password_hash, role)\"\n    66\t            \" values (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n    67\t            (email.strip().lower(), display_name, _hasher.hash(password), role))\n    68\t\n    69\t\n    70\tdef seed_demo_accounts(admin_password: str, editor_password: str) -> None:\n    71\t    \"\"\"Create the four demo Accounts. Safe to run twice.\"\"\"\n    72\t    hashes = {\"admin\": _hasher.hash(admin_password),\n    73\t              \"editor\": _hasher.hash(editor_password)}\n    74\t    init_db()\n    75\t    with connect() as conn:\n    76\t        for display_name, email, role, pw_key in DEMO_ACCOUNTS:\n    77\t            exists = conn.execute(\"select 1 from accounts where email = ?\",\n    78\t                                  (email,)).fetchone()\n    79\t            if not exists:\n    80\t                conn.execute(\n    81\t                    \"insert into accounts (email, display_name, password_hash, role)\"\n    82\t                    \" values (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n    83\t                    (email, display_name, hashes[pw_key], role))\n    84\t\n    85\t\n    86\tdef set_active(email: str, active: bool) -> None:\n    87\t    with connect() as conn:\n    88\t        conn.execute(\"update accounts set active = ? where email = ?\",\n    89\t                     (int(active), email))\n    90\t\n    91\t\n    92\tdef authenticate(email: str, password: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    93\t    \"\"\"Return the active Account for these credentials, or None.\"\"\"\n    94\t    with connect() as conn:\n    95\t        account = conn.execute(\"select * from accounts where email = ?\",\n    96\t                               (email.strip().lower(),)).fetchone()\n    97\t    stored = account[\"password_hash\"] if account else _DUMMY_HASH\n    98\t    try:\n    99\t        ok = _hasher.verify(stored, password)\n   100\t    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n   101\t        ok = False\n   102\t    return account if (ok and account and account[\"active\"]) else None\n   103\t\n   104\t\n   105\tdef get_account(account_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n   106\t    with connect() as conn:\n   107\t        return conn.execute(\"select * from accounts where id = ? and active = 1\",\n   108\t                            (account_id,)).fetchone()\n   109\t\n   110\t\n   111\t# --- sessions and CSRF -----------------------------------------------------\n   112\t\n   113\tdef sign_in(request: Request, account: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n   114\t    request.session.clear()  # new session on sign-in, with a fresh CSRF token\n   115\t    request.session[\"account_id\"] = account[\"id\"]\n   116\t    request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n   117\t\n   118\t\n   119\tdef sign_out(request: Request) -> None:\n   120\t    request.session.clear()\n   121\t\n   122\t\n   123\tdef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n   124\t    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n   125\t    if not token:\n   126\t        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n   127\t    return token\n   128\t\n   129\t\n   130\tasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n   131\t    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing route: reject a missing or bad token.\"\"\"\n   132\t    form = await request.form()\n   133\t    sent = str(form.get(\"csrf_token\", \"\"))\n   134\t    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\", \"\")\n   135\t    if not expected or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n   136\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n   137\t\n   138\t\n   139\tdef require_account(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n   140\t    \"\"\"Guard: must be signed in. Anonymous requests go to the sign-in screen.\"\"\"\n   141\t    account_id = request.session.get(\"account_id\")\n   142\t    account = get_account(account_id) if account_id else None\n   143\t    if account is None:\n   144\t        request.session.pop(\"account_id\", None)\n   145\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=303, headers={\"Location\": \"/login\"})\n   146\t    return account\n=== app/routes/posts.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Console screens for Posts: list, write, edit, publish, delete.\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\n     5\tfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\n     6\t\n     7\tfrom app import accounts, content, markdown\n     8\tfrom app.templating import templates\n     9\t\n    10\t# require_account comes first so an anonymous POST is sent to sign-in, not\n    11\t# refused for a missing token.\n    12\trouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\", dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_account)])\n    13\tcsrf = [Depends(accounts.require_csrf)]\n    14\t\n    15\tLIST_URL = \"/admin/posts\"\n    16\t\n    17\t\n    18\tdef flash(request: Request, message: str) -> None:\n    19\t    request.session[\"flash\"] = message\n    20\t\n    21\t\n    22\tdef render(request: Request, template: str, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    23\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n    24\t        request, template,\n    25\t        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\",\n    26\t         \"csrf_token\": accounts.csrf_token(request),\n    27\t         \"flash\": request.session.pop(\"flash\", \"\"), **context},\n    28\t        status_code=status_code)\n    29\t\n    30\t\n    31\tdef found(post_id: int):\n    32\t    post = content.get_post(post_id)\n    33\t    if post is None:\n    34\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Post.\")\n    35\t    return post\n    36\t\n    37\t\n    38\tdef form_error(request: Request, template: str, post, title: str, body: str):\n    39\t    return render(request, template, status_code=400, post=post, form_title=title,\n    40\t                  form_body=body, error=\"A Post needs a title.\")\n    41\t\n    42\t\n    43\t@router.get(\"\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    44\tdef list_posts(request: Request):\n    45\t    return render(request, \"admin/posts.html\", posts=content.list_posts())\n    46\t\n    47\t\n    48\t@router.get(\"/new\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    49\tdef new_post(request: Request):\n    50\t    return render(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", post=None, form_title=\"\",\n    51\t                  form_body=\"\", error=\"\")\n    52\t\n    53\t\n    54\t@router.post(\"\", dependencies=csrf)\n    55\tdef create_post(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    56\t                account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    57\t    try:\n    58\t        content.create_post(title, body, account[\"id\"])\n    59\t    except content.EmptyTitle:\n    60\t        return form_error(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", None, title, body)\n    61\t    flash(request, f\"Created Draft “{title.strip()}”.\")\n    62\t    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n    63\t\n    64\t\n    65\t@router.post(\"/preview\", response_class=HTMLResponse, dependencies=csrf)\n    66\tdef preview_post(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    67\t    \"\"\"Show the sanitized rendering of the form's text. Nothing is saved.\"\"\"\n    68\t    # The local app serves the public stylesheet at /style.css.\n    69\t    return render(request, \"admin/post_preview.html\", preview_title=title.strip(),\n    70\t                  rendered=markdown.render(body), css_path=\"/style.css\")\n    71\t\n    72\t\n    73\t@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    74\tdef edit_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    75\t    post = found(post_id)\n    76\t    return render(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", post=post, form_title=post[\"title\"],\n    77\t                  form_body=post[\"body\"], error=\"\")\n    78\t\n    79\t\n    80\t@router.post(\"/{post_id}\", dependencies=csrf)\n    81\tdef save_post(request: Request, post_id: int, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    82\t    post = found(post_id)\n    83\t    try:\n    84\t        content.update_post(post_id, title, body)\n    85\t    except content.EmptyTitle:\n    86\t        return form_error(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", post, title, body)\n    87\t    flash(request, f\"Saved “{title.strip()}”.\")\n    88\t    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n    89\t\n    90\t\n    91\t@router.post(\"/{post_id}/publish\", dependencies=csrf)\n    92\tdef publish_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    93\t    post = found(post_id)\n    94\t    content.set_status(post_id, \"published\")\n    95\t    flash(request, f\"Published “{post['title']}”. It reaches Visitors at the next Go live.\")\n    96\t    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n    97\t\n    98\t\n    99\t@router.post(\"/{post_id}/unpublish\", dependencies=csrf)\n   100\tdef unpublish_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n   101\t    post = found(post_id)\n   102\t    content.set_status(post_id, \"draft\")\n   103\t    flash(request, f\"Set “{post['title']}” back to Draft.\")\n   104\t    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n   105\t\n   106\t\n   107\t@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n   108\tdef confirm_delete(request: Request, post_id: int):\n   109\t    return render(request, \"admin/post_delete.html\", post=found(post_id))\n   110\t\n   111\t\n   112\t@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\", dependencies=csrf)\n   113\tdef delete_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n   114\t    post = found(post_id)\n   115\t    content.delete_post(post_id)\n   116\t    flash(request, f\"Deleted “{post['title']}”.\")\n   117\t    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n=== app/routes/auth.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Sign-in, sign-out, and the console front door.\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\n     5\tfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\n     6\t\n     7\tfrom app import accounts, settings\n     8\tfrom app.templating import templates\n     9\t\n    10\trouter = APIRouter()\n    11\t\n    12\tWRONG_LOGIN = \"Wrong email or password.\"\n    13\t\n    14\t\n    15\tdef login_page(request: Request, error: str = \"\", status_code: int = 200):\n    16\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n    17\t        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n    18\t        {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"home_path\": \"/\", \"error\": error,\n    19\t         \"csrf_token\": accounts.csrf_token(request)},\n    20\t        status_code=status_code)\n    21\t\n    22\t\n    23\t@router.get(\"/login\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    24\tdef login_form(request: Request):\n    25\t    return login_page(request)\n    26\t\n    27\t\n    28\t@router.post(\"/login\", dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_csrf)])\n    29\tdef login(request: Request, email: str = Form(\"\"), password: str = Form(\"\")):\n    30\t    account = accounts.authenticate(email, password)\n    31\t    if account is None:\n    32\t        return login_page(request, WRONG_LOGIN, status_code=401)\n    33\t    accounts.sign_in(request, account)\n    34\t    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n    35\t\n    36\t\n    37\t@router.post(\"/logout\", dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_csrf)])\n    38\tdef logout(request: Request):\n    39\t    accounts.sign_out(request)\n    40\t    return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n    41\t\n    42\t\n    43\t@router.get(\"/admin\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    44\tdef admin_home(request: Request, account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    45\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n    46\t        request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n    47\t        {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"account\": account,\n    48\t         \"csrf_token\": accounts.csrf_token(request)})\n=== app/cli.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n     2\t\n     3\t    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n     4\t    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n     5\t    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n     6\t\"\"\"\n     7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     8\t\n     9\timport argparse\n    10\timport subprocess\n    11\timport sys\n    12\t\n    13\tfrom app import settings\n    14\tfrom app.publish import render_site\n    15\t\n    16\t\n    17\tdef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    18\t    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    19\t    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    20\t    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    21\t    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    22\t    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    23\t files = read_all(export(tmp_path))\n    past = files[\"posts/index.html\"]\n    assert \"Charlie\" not in past\n    assert past.index(\"Bravo\") < past.index(\"Alpha\")\n    assert test_drafts_appear_nowhere_in_the_export_or_the_preview(client_as, client, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    write(c, \"Secret plans\", body=\"Hidden words\", publish=False)\n    write(c, assert len(post_files(export(tmp_path))) == 2\n    act(c, unpublished, \"unpublish\")\n    token = csrf_token(c, f\"/admin/posts/{deleted}/delete\")\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{deleted}/delete\", {"parentUuid":"edb59706-77c1-4ff4-91b3-0063783b7c3c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"d83903f5-f141-4b9b-b768-0679ea05f6a7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01WHT5kG2EDyXYJTRY3K5rS2","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n2\t\n3\tOnly PUBLISHED Posts are written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n4\tEvery href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\", \"../style.css\"),\n5\tnever root-absolute, because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n6\t\n7\tThe render_* functions are also what the local preview at / calls, so the\n8\tpreview and the export cannot disagree.\n9\t\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\timport shutil\n13\tfrom pathlib import Path\n14\t\n15\tfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n16\t\n17\tfrom markupsafe import Markup\n18\t\n19\tfrom app import content, markdown, settings\n20\t\n21\tCSS = \"\"\"/* Public site styles. */\n22\t:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\n23\tbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n24\theader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n25\tmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n26\tarticle { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n27\t.date { margin-block: 0 1rem; opacity: 0.75; }\n28\t\"\"\"\n29\t\n30\t\n31\tdef environment() -> Environment:\n32\t    return Environment(\n33\t        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n34\t        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n35\t    )\n36\t\n37\t\n38\tdef _view(row) -> dict:\n39\t    \"\"\"What a Visitor sees of a Post. The Author is deliberately not here.\"\"\"\n40\t    return {\"title\": row[\"title\"], \"link\": row[\"link\"],\n41\t            \"date\": content.public_date(row[\"first_published_at\"]),\n42\t            \"body_html\": Markup(markdown.render(row[\"body\"]))}\n43\t\n44\t\n45\tdef _render(template: str, depth: int, **context) -> str:\n46\t    up = \"../\" * depth\n47\t    return environment().get_template(template).render(\n48\t        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, css_path=f\"{up}style.css\",\n49\t        home_path=f\"{up}index.html\", **context)\n50\t\n51\t\n52\tdef render_front(rows=None) -> str:\n53\t    posts = content.published_posts() if rows is None else rows\n54\t    return _render(\"public/home.html\", 0, latest=_view(posts[0]) if posts else None,\n55\t                   past_href=\"posts/index.html\")\n56\t\n57\t\n58\tdef render_past(rows=None) -> str:\n59\t    posts = content.published_posts() if rows is None else rows\n60\t    return _render(\"public/past.html\", 1, posts=[_view(row) for row in posts[1:]])\n61\t\n62\t\n63\tdef render_post(link: str, rows=None) -> str | None:\n64\t    for row in (content.published_posts() if rows is None else rows):\n65\t        if row[\"link\"] == link:\n66\t            return _render(\"public/post.html\", 1, post=_view(row),\n67\t                           past_href=\"index.html\")\n68\t    return None\n69\t\n70\t\n71\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n72\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n73\t    rows = content.published_posts()\n74\t    # A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\nEvery href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\", \"../style.css\"),\nnever root-absolute, because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\nThe render_* functions are also what the local preview at / calls, so the\npreview and the export cannot disagree.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom markupsafe import Markup\n\nfrom app import content, markdown, settings\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Public site styles. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\narticle { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.date { margin-block: 0 1rem; opacity: 0.75; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _view(row) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"What a Visitor sees of a Post. The Author is deliberately not here.\"\"\"\n    return {\"title\": row[\"title\"], \"link\": row[\"link\"],\n            \"date\": content.public_date(row[\"first_published_at\"]),\n            \"body_html\": Markup(markdown.render(row[\"body\"]))}\n\n\ndef _render(template: str, depth: int, **context) -> str:\n    up = \"../\" * depth\n    return environment().get_template(template).render(\n        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, css_path=f\"{up}style.css\",\n        home_path=f\"{up}index.html\", **context)\n\n\ndef render_front(rows=None) -> str:\n    posts = content.published_posts() if rows is None else rows\n    return _render(\"public/home.html\", 0, latest=_view(posts[0]) if posts else None,\n                   past_href=\"posts/index.html\")\n\n\ndef render_past(rows=None) -> str:\n    posts = content.published_posts() if rows is None else rows\n    return _render(\"public/past.html\", 1, posts=[_view(row) for row in posts[1:]])\n\n\ndef render_post(link: str, rows=None) -> str | None:\n    for row in (content.published_posts() if rows is None else rows):\n        if row[\"link\"] == link:\n            return _render(\"public/post.html\", 1, post=_view(row),\n                           past_href=\"index.html\")\n    return None\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    rows = content.published_posts()\n    # Render everything before touching the folder, so a failure leaves the\n    # previous site/ in place instead of an empty one.\n    pages = {\"index.html\": render_front(rows), \"posts/index.html\": render_past(rows)}\n    for row in rows:\n        pages[f\"posts/{row['link']}.html\"] = render_post(row[\"link\"], rows)\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    (out / \"posts\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    for name, html in pages.items():\n        (out / name).write_text(html)\n    return out\n","numLines":86,"startLine":1,"totalLines":86}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"edb59706-77c1-4ff4-91b3-0063783b7c3c","session_id":"2033201e-25ce-4be7-b1a2-f9cd7e6f34fb","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/msgre/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"e127c17f-a576-48c7-b58c-59cfdf744a1e","version":"2.1.286","gitBranch":"main"}

Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, Response\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import accounts, content, publish, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth, posts\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    accounts.init_db()\n    content.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    # max_age=None: a session cookie with no Expires/Max-Age, so it ends when the\n    # browser closes.\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"session\", max_age=None,\n                       same_site=\"lax\", https_only=False)\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n\n    # The local preview of the public site: the same renderers the export uses,\n    # at the same relative paths, so it shows Published content only.\n    @app.get(\"/\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_home():\n        return publish.render_front()\n\n    @app.get(\"/style.css\")\n    def public_css():\n        return Response(publish.CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n\n    @app.get(\"/posts/index.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_past():\n        return publish.render_past()\n\n    @app.get(\"/posts/{link}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_post(link: str):\n        page = publish.render_post(link)\n        if page is None:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Post.\")\n        return page\n\n    # Iterator\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\nfrom fastapi import HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Verified against when the email is unknown, so both failures take similar time.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(\"not-a-real-password\")\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\ncreate table if not exists accounts (\n    id integer primary key,\n    email text not null unique,\n    display_name text not null,\n    password_hash text not null,\n    role text not null check (role in ('admin', uses.\nDEMO_ACCOUNTS = [\n    (\"Co-VP\", \"admin@example.test\", \"admin\", \"admin\"),\n    (\"Social Chair\", \"editor@example.test\", \"editor\", \"editor\"),\n    (\"Co-President\", \"copresident@example.test\", \"editor\", \"editor\"),\n    (\"Treasurer\", \"treasurer@example.test\", \"editor\", \"editor\"),\n]\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        with conn:\n            yield conn\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef init_db() -> None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(SCHEMA)\n\n\ndef create_account(email: str, display_name: str, password: str, role: str) -> None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"insert into accounts (email, display_name, password_hash, role)\"\n            \" values (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email.strip().lower(), display_name, _hasher.hash(password), role))\n\n\ndef seed_demo_accounts(admin_password: str, editor_password: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the four demo Accounts. Safe to run twice.\"\"\"\n    hashes = {\"admin\": _hasher.hash(admin_password),\n              \"editor\": _hasher.hash(editor_password)}\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        for display_name, email, role, pw_key in DEMO_ACCOUNTS:\n            exists = conn.execute(\"select 1 from accounts where email = ?\",\n                                  (email,)).fetchone()\n            if not exists:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"insert into accounts (email, display_name, password_hash, role)\"\n                    \" values (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (email, display_name, hashes[pw_key], role))\n\n\ndef set_active(email: str, active: bool) -> None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"update accounts set active = ? where email = ?\",\n                     (int(active), email))\n\n\ndef authenticate(email: str, password: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the active Account for these credentials, or None.\"\"\"\n    with connect() as conn:\n        account = conn.execute(\"select * from accounts where email = ?\",\n                               (email.strip().lower(),)).fetchone()\n    stored = account[\"password_hash\"] if account else _DUMMY_HASH\n    try:\n        ok = _hasher.verify(stored, password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        ok = False\n    return account if (ok and account and account[\"active\"]) else None\n\n\ndef get_account(account_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"select * from accounts where id = ? and active = 1\",\n                            (account_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\n# --- sessions and CSRF -----------------------------------------------------\n\ndef sign_in(request: Request, account: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()  # new session on sign-in, with a fresh CSRF token\n    request.session[\"account_id\"] = account[\"id\"]\n    request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n\n\ndef sign_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing route: reject a missing or bad token.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    sent = str(form.get(\"csrf_token\", \"\"))\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\", \"\")\n    if not expected or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n\n\ndef require_account(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Guard: must be signed in. Anonymous requests go to the sign-in screen.\"\"\"\n    account_id = request.session.get(\"account_id\")\n    account = get_account(account_id) if account_id else None\n    if account is None:\n        request.session.pop(\"account_id\", None)\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=303, headers={\"Location\": \"/login\"})\n    return account\n","numLines":147,"startLine":1,"totalLines":147}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"44bdb56f-4067-4a78-9425-6f8630620596","session_id":"2033201e-25ce-4be7-b1a2-f9cd7e6f34fb","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/msgre/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"e127c17f-a576-48c7-b58c-59cfdf744a1e","version":"2.1.286","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"05644c12-e582-417c-aa70-70a07baa819f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"d83903f5-f141-4b9b-b768-0679ea05f6a7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Brpi4A7vudh6v7zBYHMdW2","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The shared Jinja environment.\"\"\"\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import content, settings\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\ntemplates.env.globals[\"eastern\"] = content.eastern\n\"\"\"Markdown to sanitized HTML, in one place.\n\nThe editor Preview, the local public preview, and the export all call\nrender(), so nothing can be shown unsanitized. Raw HTML typed into a body is\nstripped by the allowlist, images are not on it, and only absolute http(s) and\nmailto links survive (a root-absolute link would break the relative-paths rule).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\nALLOWED_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"strong\", \"em\", \"a\", \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\", \"blockquote\", \"code\",\n                \"pre\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"hr\"}\nALLOWED_SCHEMES = {\"http\", \"https\", \"mailto\"}\n\n_parser = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True}).disable(\"image\")\n\n\ndef render(body: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(\n        _parser.render(body),\n        tags=ALLOWED_TAGS,\n        attributes={\"a\": {\"href\"}},\n        url_schemes=ALLOWED_SCHEMES,\n        url_relative=\"deny\",\n    )\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import envfile\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n# .env fills in anything the real environment leaves unset. CMS_ENV_FILE\n# points elsewhere (the tests use it to keep a developer's .env out).\nenvfile.load(os.environ.get(\"CMS_ENV_FILE\", ROOT / \".env\"))\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\nDATABASE_PATH = Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n\"\"\"Sign-in, sign-out, and the console front door.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import accounts, settings\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nWRONG_LOGIN = \"Wrong email or password.\"\n\n\ndef login_page(request: Request, error: str = \"\", status_code: int = 200):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n        {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"home_path\": \"/\", \"error\": error,\n         \"csrf_token\": accounts.csrf_token(request)},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    return login_page(request)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\", dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_csrf)])\ndef login(request: Request, email: str = Form(\"\"), password: str = Form(\"\")):\n    account = accounts.authenticate(email, password)\n    if account is None:\n        return login_page(request, WRONG_LOGIN, status_code=401)\n    accounts.sign_in(request, account)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\", dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_csrf)])\ndef logout(request: Request):\n    accounts.sign_out(request)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef admin_home(request: Request, account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"account\": account,\n         \"csrf_token\": accounts.csrf_token(request)})\n\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n\n    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        out = render_site()\n        print(f\"Wrote {out}. Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {out} 8001\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n        return result.returncode\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n\"\"\"T00: the walking skeleton. These pass in the fresh template.\n\nDo not delete them. If a change breaks them, the change broke the app's front\ndoor.\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_admin_console_answers(client, client_as):\n    anonymous = client.get(\"/admin\", follow_redirects=False)\n Pages make up the site: Home, About, Join & Snacks.\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_token\nfrom tests.test_t01 import rows, run_seed\nfrom tests.test_t02 import act, create, newest_id\nfrom tests.test_t03 import XSS_BODY, read_all, write\n\nPAGES = \"/admin/pages\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef site_title(monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE_TITLE\", \"AWM at Kenyon\")\n\n\ndef export(tmp_path):\n    return render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n\ndef page_ids(c):\n    return [int(i) for i in re.findall(r\"/admin/pages/(\\d+)/edit\", c.get(PAGES).text)]\n\n\ndef page_id_titled(c, title):\n    \"\"\"The id of the Page whose row in the list names this title.\"\"\"\n    for page_id in page_ids(c):\n        if title in c.get(f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/edit\").text:\n            return page_id\n    raise AssertionError(f\"no Page titled {title!r}\")\n\n\ndef new_page(c, title=\"Meetings\", body=\"Body text.\"):\n    token = csrf_token(c, f\"{PAGES}/new\")\n    response = c.post(PAGES, data={\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code in (302, 303), response.text\n    return max(page_ids(c))\n\n\ndef post_page(c, path, form_path=None, **fields):\n    token = csrf_token(c, form_path or PAGES)\n    return c.post(path, data={**fields, \"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef edit_page(c, page_id, **fields):\n    return post_page(c, f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}\", f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/edit\", **fields)\n\n\ndef publish_page(c, page_id):\n    return post_page(c, f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/publish\", f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/edit\")\n\n\ndef unpublish_page(c, page_id):\n    return post_page(c, f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/unpublish\", f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/edit\")\n\n\ndef delete_page(c, page_id):\n    return post_page(c, f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/delete\", f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/edit\")\n\n\ndef home_id(c):\n    return page_id_titled(c, \"Home\")\n\n\ndef nav_links(html):\n    nav = re.search(r\"<nav.*?</nav>\", html, re.DOTALL)\n    assert nav, \"every public page needs a <nav>\"\n    return re.findall(r'href=\"([^\"]+)\"', nav.group(0))\n\n\n# --- seed script -----------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_seed_creates_the_three_pages_in_order_and_twice_makes_no_duplicates(tmp_path):\n    db = tmp_path / \"seed.db\"\n    assert run_seed(db).returncode == 0\n    assert run_seed(db).returncode == 0\n    found = rows(db, \"select title, status from pages order by created_at, id\")\n    assert found == [(\"Home\", \"published\"), (\"About\", \"published\"),\n                     (\"Join & Snacks\", \"published\")]\n\n\ndef test_home_exists_and_is_listed_without_the_seed_script(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"editor\").get(PAGES).text\n    assert \"Home\" in page and len(page_ids(client_as(\"editor\"))) == 1\n\n\ndef test_export_without_the_seed_script_still_writes_home(tmp_path):\n    out = export(tmp_path)\n    assert (out / \"index.html\").exists()\n    assert nav_links((out / \"index.html\").read_text()) == [\"index.html\"]\n\n\n# --- the exported site -------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_export_writes_one_file_per_published_page_named_by_its_link(client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    about = new_page(c, \"About\")\n    publish_page(c, about)\n    new_page(c, \"Join & Snacks\")  # stays Draft\n    out = export(tmp_path)\n    assert sorted(p.name for p in out.glob(\"*.html\")) == [\"about.html\", \"index.html\"]\n\n\ndef test_every_exported_file_has_the_same_navigation(client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for title in (\"About\", \"Join & Snacks\"):\n        publish_page(c, new_page(c, title))\n    write(client_as(\"editor\"), \"Study Hall tonight\")\n    out = export(tmp_path)\n    files = {n: t for n, t in read_all(out).items() if n.endswith(\".html\")}\n    assert {\"index.html\", \"about.html\", \"join-snacks.html\", \"posts/index.html\"} <= set(files)\n    for name, text in files.items():\n        up = \"../\" if name.startswith(\"posts/\") else \"\"\n        assert nav_links(text) == [f\"{up}index.html\", f\"{up}about.html\",\n                                   f\"{up}join-snacks.html\"], name\n    assert all(\"Past posts\" not in re.search(r\"<nav.*?</nav>\", t, re.DOTALL).group(0)\n               for t in files.values())\n\n\ndef test_navigation_follows_creation_order_not_title_order(client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for title in (\"Zebra\", \"Apple\"):\n        publish_page(c, new_page(c, title))\n    assert nav_links(read_all(export(tmp_path))[\"index.html\"]) == [\n        \"index.html\", \"zebra.html\", \"apple.html\"]\n\n\ndef test_a_draft_page_has_no_file_and_is_not_in_the_navigation(client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    new_page(c, \"Secret page\", body=\"Hidden words\")\n    out = export(tmp_path)\n    assert not (out / \"secret-page.html\").exists()\n    for name, text in read_all(out).items():\n        assert \"Secret page\" not in text and \"Hidden words\" not in text, name\n\n\ndef test_unpublishing_a_page_removes_it_from_the_next_export(client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    about = new_page(c, \"About\")\n    publish_page(c, about)\n    assert (export(tmp_path) / \"about.html\").exists()\n    unpublish_page(c, about)\n    out = export(tmp_path)\n    assert not (out / \"about.html\").exists()\n    assert \"about.html\" not in read_all(out)[\"index.html\"]\n\n\ndef test_exported_home_shows_its_body_above_the_latest_post(client_as, tmp_path):\n    write(client_as(\"editor\"), \"Latest news\", body=\"Latest words\")\n    html = read_all(export(tmp_path))[\"index.html\"]\n    assert \"Hayes 311\" in html and \"Latest words\" in html\n    assert html.index(\"Hayes 311\") < html.index(\"Latest news\")\n\n\ndef test_changing_the_room_in_home_replaces_it_everywhere_in_the_export(client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    write(client_as(\"editor\"), \"Weekly\", body=\"See you there.\")\n    assert \"Hayes 311\" in read_all(export(tmp_path))[\"index.html\"]\n    edit_page(c, home_id(c), title=\"Home\", body=\"Study Hall is Mondays, 8-10pm in Olin 101.\")\n    files = read_all(export(tmp_path))\n    assert \"Olin 101\" in files[\"index.html\"]\n    assert not any(\"Hayes 311\" in text for text in files.values())\n\n\ndef test_page_body_with_script_and_onerror_is_harmless_in_export_and_preview(\n        client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    about = new_page(c, \"About\", body=XSS_BODY)\n    publish_page(c, about)\n    for name, text in read_all(export(tmp_path)).items():\n        assert \"<script\" not in text.lower() and \"onerror\" not in text.lower(), name\n    token = csrf_token(c, f\"{PAGES}/new\")\n    preview = c.post(f\"{PAGES}/preview\",\n                     data={\"title\": \"About\", \"body\": XSS_BODY, \"csrf_token\": token}).text\n    assert \"<script\" not in preview.lower() and \"onerror\" not in preview.lower()\n    local = c.get(\"/about.html\").text\n    assert \"<script\" not in local.lower() and \"onerror\" not in local.lower()\n\n\ndef test_no_exported_page_uses_root_absolute_paths_and_nav_points_at_real_files(\n        client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for title in (\"About\", \"Join & Snacks\"):\n        publish_page(c, new_page(c, title))\n    write(client_as(\"editor\"), \"One\")\n    out = export(tmp_path)\n    for name, text in read_all(out).items():\n        if name.endswith(\".html\"):\n            assert 'href=\"/' not in text and 'src=\"/' not in text, name\n            base = (out / name).parent\n            for href in nav_links(text):\n                assert (base / href).resolve().is_file(), (name, href)\n\n\ndef test_local_preview_serves_published_pages_and_hides_drafts(client, client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    about = new_page(c, \"About\", body=\"About words\")\n    new_page(c, \"Secret page\")\n    assert client.get(\"/about.html\").status_code == 404\n    publish_page(c, about)\n    assert \"About words\" in client.get(\"/about.html\").text\n    assert client.get(\"/secret-page.html\").status_code == 404\n    assert \"about.html\" in client.get(\"/\").text\n\n\n# --- Admin: create, rename, status, delete --------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_creates_a_page_sets_it_to_published_and_back_to_draft(client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page_id = new_page(c, page_id).status_code in (302, 303)\n    assert \"Meeting words\" in read_all(export(tmp_path))[\"meetings.html\"]\n    assert unpublish_page(c, page_id).status_code in (302, 303)\n    assert \"Study Halls\" in files[\"meetings.html\"]\n    assert \"Study Halls\" in files[\"index.html\"]\n\n\ndef test_admin_deletes_a_page_only_after_a_confirmation_screen(client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = sure\" in confirm.text\n    assert page_id in page_ids(c)\n    assert delete_page(c, page_id).status_code in (302, 303)\n    assert page_id not in page_ids(c)\n    assert \"temporary.html\" not in form = c.get(path).text.lower()\n        assert 'name=\"link\"' not in form and 'name=\"slug\"' not in form\n\n\ndef test_a_link_typed_into_the_request_is_ignored(client_as, tmp_path):\n    c = publish_page(admin, about)\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = edit_page(c, about, title=\"Hijacked\", status=\"draft\", body=\"New body\")\n    assert response.status_code in (302, 303)\n \"/admin/pages\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef site_title(monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE_TITLE\", \"AWM at Kenyon\")\n\n\ndef export(tmp_path):\n    return edit_page(c, page_id, **fields):\n    return post_page(c, f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}\", f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/edit\", **fields)\n\n\ndef publish_page(c, page_id):\n    return post_page(c,  nav = re.search(r\"<nav.*?</nav>\", html, re.DOTALL)\n    assert nav, \"every public page needs a <nav>\"\n    return re.findall(r'href=\"([^\"]+)\"', nav.group(0))\n\n\n# --- seed script
